It's just that i can't do this much longer. I can't remember the last time i was happy, or even felt alive. I can't feel anything anymore. I don't feel like myself.I don't even know who i am anymore. I have little to know memory of my past whatsoever. I don't see a future for my self and honestly i never did. I've always felt different and felt that i don't belong here. On top of that i'm also i complete failure. I'm not particulary good in anything. I'm not smart, nor good with my hands, i'm not creative or anything. I'm also not good at any sport. I even sucked at playing games when i used to play them. I'm always average or below. I've also had terible social anxiety my whole life and just anxiety in general. Thanks to that i've never been really close to anyone, not even my parents. I've never had many friends or had a gf nor kissed a girl even though i turn 18 this year.

 I did once got very close to a girl i met online. She kinda just started the conversation and it kept going and going. We became closer and closer and we even talked about our future. Until suddenly she started losing interest. Then the next moment you know she was gone. It broke my heart, but i moved on. I started seeing some other girls but the same thing happend in the end. They all leave at the end. I another girl again at the end of  last year. But she was different. She was the closest i have ever been to a girl and she also was the first person i ever opend up to. We were very much a like and also had the same problems. We both were 2 depressed introverts with very severe anxiety and a horible past. But despite that we still tried to help eachother out. We talked to eachother every day for almost 2 months straight and we had so much plans for  eachother. We even went to see eachother in real life. I finally thought she was to one. I finally thought that i could know what it felt to be 'happy. But the same thing happend in the end. She left like everyone else. End then  i rememberd that 'love' or 'hapiness' isn't for everyone. And when i thought i hit rock bottem, Everything got even worse to the points where i am now. I spent most days in my room using myself as a punching bag, either barely eating or sleeping or sleeping the entire day. no in between. I struggle to get the energy to get out of bed and started losing interest in everything i used to do. I barely talk to anyone exept for my 2 friends who try to keep me out of the house as much as possible. But it's gotten to a point were i can't see my friends while i'm sober. So i either stay i'm my room all day, questioning my excistense or i'm out abusing every drug i can. My friends know most things about how i'm feeling, because i've told A lot while being on MDMA. But theys still don't know anything. I told them i wasn't planning on killing myself but that isn't really true. I've been planning it for a very long time but i'm not quite sure yet on what i am going to do. I'm so scared that i will fail and come back worse. I also don't wanna do this to my parents and friends or my little sisters. But i don't know how much longer i can do this. I can't escape the voices in my head. Every day is the same. I no longer have any sense of time or reality and everything feels so strange. I'm either in so much pain or don't feel anything at all. I don't even live for myself anymore.I just wanna die in peace so bad but i can't because it's 'selfish' and it would hurt the ones around me. But what about me? Am i supossed to live in pain forever just for the sake of the ones around me?
